writing.explanation: Atomicity, consistency, and durability are easy to state. Isolation is a dial: read committed still allows non-repeatable reads, repeatable read still allows phantoms in some engines, and serializable costs the most because it must behave as if transactions ran one at a time. Naming your database default is what separates a real answer from a memorised one.
